description: A classic fantasy realm where three factions vie for control after the old empire collapsed, and wild magic threatens to consume everything.

factions.name: The Iron Council
factions.description: Pragmatic former generals who seized power promising order and stability
tensions: Internal corruption is weakening their legitimacy
Conflict with the Mage's Circle over magic prohibition
Military forces stretched thin across too many territories

factions.name: The Mage's Circle
factions.description: Ancient order of mages who believe magic should be freely studied and practiced
tensions: Divided between conservative and radical factions
Some members experimenting with forbidden rituals

factions.name: The Free Cities Alliance
factions.description: Coalition of merchant republics seeking independence and prosperity
goals: Prevent any single faction from dominating
tensions: Economic rivalry between member cities causing fractures
Secret deals with both Iron Council and Mage's Circle
Smuggling operations enabling black market magic

factions.name: Twilight Pilgrims
factions.description: Mysterious religious movement claiming the old gods are returning
tensions: Rumored to be harboring dangerous artifacts
Leadership may be influenced by otherworldly entities

locations.name: Ashwood Crossing
locations.description: A frontier town at the edge of Iron Council territory
locations.atmosphere: Tense, lawless at night, refugees flood in daily

locations.name: Crystalspire Ruins
locations.description: Former Mage's Circle academy, now a haunted ruin after a ritual went wrong
locations.atmosphere: Eerie, magical anomalies, treasure hunters disappear here

locations.name: Silverhaven Port
locations.description: Wealthiest of the Free Cities, built on trade and secrets
locations.atmosphere: Bustling, cosmopolitan, everyone has an agenda

locations.name: Ironhold Fortress
locations.description: The Iron Council's seat of power, a repurposed imperial fortress

locations.name: The Whispering Forest
locations.description: Ancient woodland where reality is thin and spirits walk

locations.name: Ember Monastery
locations.description: Twilight Pilgrims' hidden sanctuary in the mountains
locations.atmosphere: Serene but unsettling, chanting echoes day and night

twists.description: Your trusted companion is actually a spy for the Iron Council, sent to monitor your activities
The artifact you've been seeking is cursed and will doom whoever wields it to become a vessel for an ancient evil
You are actually the lost heir to the fallen empire, and all factions have been manipulating you
The wild magic surges aren't natural — someone is deliberately destabilizing reality as part of a ritual
The Twilight Pilgrims' prophecy is real, but it predicts destruction, not salvation

starter_hooks.opening: You wake up in a tavern with no memory of last night. Your coin pouch is gone, but there's a strange glowing amulet in your pocket. The bartender is staring at you nervously.
initial_options: Ask the bartender what happened last night

starter_hooks.opening: You're traveling through Ashwood Crossing when Iron Council soldiers stop your cart. They're searching for 'magic contraband.' Your cargo is legitimate, but there's a hidden compartment you didn't know about...
initial_options: Cooperate fully and hope for the best

starter_hooks.opening: A hooded stranger slips you a sealed letter in the market, then vanishes into the crowd. The letter bears the seal of the Mage's Circle and contains coordinates to Crystalspire Ruins along with a cryptic message: 'They know what you are.'
initial_options: Try to find the hooded stranger
Burn the letter and pretend this never happened

starter_hooks.opening: You've been having the same dream for a week: a voice calling your name from the Whispering Forest, promising answers about your past. Tonight, you wake to find fresh mud on your boots and a map to the forest on your nightstand. You don't remember drawing it.
initial_options: Follow the map into the Whispering Forest
Seek help from a local priest or healer
Investigate who might have entered your room

starter_hooks.opening: While traveling, you hear screams from a nearby wagon under attack by bandits. As you approach, you realize one of the captives is wearing Mage's Circle robes and seems to be trying to cast a spell despite having their hands bound.
initial_options: Charge in and fight the bandits
Try to negotiate with the bandits
Help the mage break free with magic
